capabilities: publish the current note to the web
unpublish a note from the web
copy the published note's URL to the clipboard
extras: The site's source code is available and users can self-host their own version, provided it follows the same URL patterns. Deleting a feed does not delete its published notes; each must be unpublished manually. README contains spelling errors.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in, simple way to push a single note to a public web page with a shareable link.

requires.name: Orion hosted site (orion.seancollings.dev) or a self-hosted version of it

summary: Publishes individual notes to a hosted website with shareable URLs, optional feed grouping, and a configurable custom domain.
